citation_system: theory file and the Isabelle name of the axiom, definition, theorem or lemma (e.g. GoedelGod.thy, A1a; GoedelGod.thy, T3), as in the AFP release of 2026-02-06 (Isabelle2025-2)
notes: Formalization reference for Scott's variant (#134), BSD license. Pinned as the web snapshot AFP-GOEDELGOD-THY of the raw GoedelGod.thy file at immutable commit b26968905efa0067a72393ef50164ad63786a7a1 of the official Isabelle Git mirror; raw-text extraction avoids interpreting Isabelle's angle-bracket syntax as HTML. This theory file's byte SHA-256 matches the independently pinned source in the AFP release tarball afp-GoedelGod-2026-02-06.tar.gz (sha256 1a907c6e705009ebe67a3e30d0e550b9d94f8d12b9d4d93258f74347a442b031; GoedelGod/GoedelGod.thy sha256 6a9e3d58c51754c9ccb86d94762a076c133df36aca4aa2d5b046d76b4f4d011a, Git blob 938bc64cb9ce48c1b1853d64ab2594b8ba64b43b), which was also the current release when pinned. The old AFP browser_info/current/ rendered HTML page disappeared (HTTP 404 on 2026-10-26). The new witness is bound to an immutable Git revision and the source release's exact file bytes instead of the moving HTML page; if a future edition differs, it must receive a separate witness and source rereading. The theory is a secondary witness for Scott's notes, which the theory cites as 'Appendix B: Notes in Dana Scott's Hand' in J. H. Sobel, Logic and Theism, pp. 145-146, which are not pinned. Claims attribute what the AFP theory states. They do not say what Gödel or Scott intended, and a proof of a theorem of the theory does not establish that.
